proposal.reason: Main change is a new extension-kernel AllReduce strategy (OneShotPush): new plugin-provided kernel, strategy/index wiring, workspace regions, topology-gated default selection, and plugin ABI/lifecycle integration across ext-kernel and loader paths. Dispatch is also substantive because Push block limits and launch sizing now depend on CU availability and dispatch masks (one-block-per-usable-CU policy), which changes CU/CE hardware launch behavior.
